Author: Aaryan Bhargava

Date: October 2026
STATUS: VERCEL PRODUCTION LIVE

Product thesis

Dayframe aims to remove the Setup Tax of organising your day. Instead of building databases in Notion or hand-filling calendar slots, the user dumps messy input (typed text, a voice note, a screenshot or receipt) and the app sorts it into tasks, time blocks and expenses, then shows the day on a 24-hour circular dial.

Central teardown question

Does Dayframe save net time end-to-end, or does it just move the work from manual entry to reviewing and fixing AI mistakes?
The reference draft estimates planning drops from ~22 min (manual setup) to under 90 s if extraction accuracy stays above ~90%. That is a hypothesis to validate with real user testing, not merely an assumed result.

Verdict at a glance

Area Verdict Why
Core idea Strong One capture box feeding tasks, schedule and money is a clear wedge; the 24h dial is a real differentiator for time-blind users.
Capture UX Strong Text, voice, audio file, image upload and Ctrl+V screenshot paste, all in one place. Guest mode means zero signup wall.
Trust and privacy Needs work Sign-in asks only name and email (no password step visible) while the page claims 100% private and encrypted. Claims should match mechanism via OAuth/OTP.
Money layer Distinctive Bank SMS / UPI auto-log via webhook is powerful for India, but setup (MacroDroid + local IP / ngrok) is power-user only.
Retention loop Gap Day view is static: no ripple reschedule when meetings overrun, and 7-day journal auto-purge works against habit building unless Drive is connected.
Monetisation Plausible Freemium at $8 / Rs 499 per month fits; AI cost caps on the free tier are the key commercial lever.

Screen Strengths PM evaluation and risk
AI Brain Dump One box, five input types (Voice, Audio file, Image OCR, Ctrl+V, Text), Hinglish friendly, keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+Enter). Risk: if confidence is hidden, users re-check every item. Needs a lightweight review step (P1).
Plan my day + dial Spatial view beats a linear list for time-blind users. Continuous 24h cycle anchors biological circadian rhythm. Gap: Does it handle overruns and travel time? Currently static without auto-ripple rescheduling.
Money and Wealth Currency switcher (INR/USD/EUR), daily spend, net-asset tracking, bank SMS auto-log. Are users comfortable mixing finances into a planner? Local-first storage helps with trust.
Focus, Distraction, Not-to-do Pomodoro tied to a task; distraction log; guardrail rules ("No phone before morning block"). Productivity score (86/100) needs transparent logic or it becomes an arbitrary vanity metric.
Export Excel-ready CSV with UTF-8 BOM, developer JSON backup/restore. Excellent for freelancers and portability; completely avoids vendor lock-in.

5. Technical & System Architecture (Mermaid Topologies)

Dayframe implements a Local-First, Edge-Assisted hybrid architecture. Client-side state operates with zero latency, while compute-heavy multimodal extraction routes through Groq LPUs (<800ms) and persists to Supabase Cloud PostgreSQL.

6. Database Schema & Entity Relational Design (ERD)

Multi-tenant persistence tier powered by Supabase PostgreSQL with Row-Level Security (RLS). Each user's data is strictly partitioned by authenticated Google UID with local-first JSON fallback.

Figure 6.1: Entity-Relationship Diagram (Supabase Postgres Data Model) 100% Data Isolation per User
erDiagram USER_PLANNER ||--o{ TASK : contains USER_PLANNER ||--o{ SCHEDULE_BLOCK : schedules USER_PLANNER ||--o{ FINANCIAL_RECORD : logs USER_PLANNER ||--o{ MILESTONE : tracks USER_PLANNER ||--o{ NOT_TO_DO : guards USER_PLANNER { string email PK "User Primary Key" string user_name "User Display Name" timestamp last_synced "Last Sync Time" jsonb settings "Theme, Currency, Config" } TASK { uuid id PK string title "Task Title" string priority "high | med | low" string category "Work | Health | Personal" int duration_mins "Estimated Minutes" boolean completed "Status" } SCHEDULE_BLOCK { uuid id PK string title "Block Title" string start_time "HH:mm" string end_time "HH:mm" float dial_angle_start "0 to 360 deg" float dial_angle_end "0 to 360 deg" } FINANCIAL_RECORD { uuid id PK string type "income | expense" string item "Item Description" float amount "Transaction Amount" string category "Food | Transport | Bills" } MILESTONE { uuid id PK string goal_title "Goal Description" int progress_pct "0 to 100%" date target_date "Target Completion" } NOT_TO_DO { uuid id PK string bad_habit "Anti-habit trigger" boolean active "Active Guardrail" }

7. Friction analysis (The Good & The Bad)

What works (Delight & Advantages) Friction points (Risks & Bottlenecks)
• Zero-setup Guest mode: No signup wall, instant value on second 1.
• Multimodal capture: Voice, receipt image & text feel blazing fast (<800ms).
• Circular 24h dial: Completely eliminates linear list time-blindness.
• SMS/UPI auto-log: Genuine India-first wedge for automated expense logging.
• Excel-ready CSV export: Clean UTF-8 BOM spreadsheet downloads. 		• Dense single-page layout: Tasks, calendar, money, habits compete for attention.
• Fixing wrong AI slots requires opening modal dialogues.
• Static schedule: Schedules do not ripple when a task overruns.
• SMS sync friction: Needs third-party MacroDroid and reachable webhook.
• Ephemeral journal: Auto-purges after 7 days unless Drive is linked.

9. How to defend this teardown: three experiments

Experiment Method Signal
User problem discovery Interview 8 working professionals about friction across WhatsApp, calendar and Splitwise; track who drops to-do apps within 7 days. Is the fragmentation pain real and frequent?
Messy-input stress test Run 20 chaotic inputs: Hinglish with traffic noise, blurry receipts, conflicting 2 PM meetings. Error rate and recovery cost per input.
A/B ripple reschedule Cohort A reschedules manually; Cohort B gets a 1-tap Auto-Rebalance prompt. Day-14 retention delta.
